description: Execution-adapter resilience and tolerance of irregular commands: action entries that match none of the known verbs are silently ignored while valid log entries interleaved among them are still recorded in order; a command whose top-level value is not an object (a bare JSON scalar) is tolerated and records nothing with a zero count; and a command object lacking an actions key records nothing with a zero count.

cases.expected_output:
primary level=1 source=x message=survives backtrace= env= valid_encoding=true
primary level=2 source=y message=second backtrace= env= valid_encoding=true
primary total=2
